evals.prompt:
For each request, say whether `contract-cartographer` should be used and why.

A. `Fix the off-by-one bug in paginator.ts.`
B. `Refactor the billing module to make it cleaner.`
C. `Design a new checkout architecture for our next app.`
D. `Map the contract around billing/applyCredits.ts; callers seem to know too much and tests mock half the module.`
evals.expected_output: The response should use the skill only for D. A is ordinary bugfix work, B is too generic unless reframed as contract diagnosis, and C is greenfield architecture design rather than existing-code contract diagnosis.
assertions: Says not to use the skill for A because it is an ordinary bugfix request.
Says not to use the skill for B unless it is reframed as existing-code contract diagnosis.
Says not to use the skill for C because greenfield architecture design is outside this diagnostic scope.
Says to use the skill for D because it explicitly asks for contract mapping around existing code with caller/test boundary concerns.
